name: memory_archive
description: Archives one memory of this workspace so memory_search no longer shows it, or restores an archived one. Use it when the user says a memory is wrong, outdated or no longer relevant, or asks to bring one back; when a fact changed, archive the old memory and store the new one with memory_remember. It needs the id: call memory_search first. Nothing is deleted and it can always be undone; only the user can delete memories, by hand. Returns the memory's line and its new state.

id.description: The memory's id, as memory_search shows it (e.g. 42).

restore.description: true to bring an archived memory back into search; leave it out to archive (e.g. true).
